description:
FHFA conforming loan limit, FHA loan limit and VA county loan limit for one US county (any of the 3,144
        counties in the 50 states and DC), for 1 to 4 unit homes, for the year in effect today, plus next year's once
        FHFA (late November) or HUD (December) has published it.
        `state`: two-letter code or name ("TX", "Texas"). `county`: name or FIPS ("Harris", "Harris County", "48201",
        "St. Louis city", "Orleans Parish"). Returns the limits, whether the county is high-cost, HUD's area and median
        price behind the FHA limit, the state range, the page URL and sources.
name: county_loan_limits
